definitions.explanation: A small hollow that appears in the cheek when someone smiles. Considered charming, especially on women and children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧えくぼ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧えくぼ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{両|りょう}{頬|ほお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧えくぼ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧。
examples.english: When the baby laughs, cute dimples appear in both cheeks.

notes:
Written {笑窪|えくぼ} in kanji, but kana is usual.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- えくぼ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: to dimple, dimples appear
- えくぼ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: dimples show
- ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧えくぼ: a dimple in one cheek only

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦あばた→あばた：08978_abata⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧えくぼ: love is blind (literally "even pockmarks look like dimples")
